wins: Executed initial reconnaissance and discovered open HTTP service, enabling further enumeration.
Captured service banners that matched known vulnerable versions, informing targeted exploitation paths.
fails: Failed to achieve any successful compromises, with success rate 0% despite 15 mentor calls.
No lateral movement or privilege escalation achieved; operation stalled after initial enumeration.
key_outcomes.summary: Recon phase identified potential targets but lacked follow-through to exploitation and persistence, resulting in incomplete kill chain.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Stalled after initial reconnaissance without progressing to exploitation

skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted nmap HTTP scripts and nikto to enumerate vulnerabilities

skill_cards.if_condition: When service versions match known CVEs
skill_cards.then_action: Develop exploit strategy using Metasploit auxiliary module or custom script

skill_cards.if_condition: When privileged credential harvest yields valid SSH login
skill_cards.then_action: Initiate SSH session with key-based or password auth, then enumerate SUID binaries for escalation

Need to strengthen exploitation planning based on enumeration.
